blurb: Torrey's Burnt Creek Inn Cabins & RV Park, located directly on the Salmon River between Stanley and Challis, in the Sawtooth National Recreation Area, is the perfect Idaho getaway and location. Featuring a general store, clean, comfortable cabins with cooking facilities, bathrooms, outdoor grills, and just steps from the Salmon River.
